verdict.rationale: The evidence covers FIDO2/WebAuthn compatibility, OpenSSH usage, and on-device fingerprint matching for login and authentication. Nothing documents a touch-to-approve gate for sensitive automated or agent-initiated actions, or even explicit per-operation touch confirmation. Wiring a key into an agent's workflow through OpenSSH or a WebAuthn relying party would be a user-side or host-platform arrangement, not a capability Feitian documents for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require a physical key touch as the human-approval step for sensitive automated or agent-initiated actions
